author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.5.0 — Fixes LimitExceededException ("generates excessive hub load") firing on every scheduled poll. The poll now uses asynchttpGet exclusively instead of blocking httpGet, since Hubitat throttles apps that make synchronous HTTP calls from a scheduled job. Command dispatches (start/pause/dock/cleanRooms/etc.) remain synchronous for now, being one-shot and not on a tight repeating schedule.
